title: Claude gets a shorter model name
summary:
Text model routing got simpler, while Claude 3.5 Haiku got a shorter model name that callers will need to adopt.

The model list now uses `claude` for Claude 3.5 Haiku instead of `claude-hybridspace`. Callers using the old name need to update it.

Routing for `qwen-coder`, `mistral`, `llama-scaleway`, `llamalight-scaleway`, and `deepseek-r1-llama` now goes through Portkey, with their model-specific prompts retained.

The separate Cloudflare text client was removed in favor of the existing Portkey route.
